title: Markets turn lower after a firmer start
summary: Indian equities opened with a constructive tone on Thursday before early gains faded. Technology shares were a relative bright spot.

sections.heading: Early trade
sections.body: Kotak Neo's morning report described both benchmark indices turning lower after opening higher. The report was an intraday snapshot, not the closing result.

sections.heading: Sector divergence
sections.body: HDFC SKY reported that technology stocks were relatively strong in early trading while consumer staples, automobiles and cement lagged.

sections.heading: Global context
sections.body: Investors were following Asian markets, oil prices and US inflation developments. The session was still in progress when this edition was prepared.
